name: Jari Mäkinen
bio:
Jari Mäkinen's career began in the Finnish rally scene, wrenching on cars in his youth before transitioning to a team management role. His meticulous attention to detail and relentless pursuit of efficiency quickly set him apart. He joined Carlin Academy five years ago, drawn by their commitment to developing young talent. 

Mäkinen's approach centers on optimizing every aspect of the team's operations, from logistics to pit stop strategies. He believes in data-driven decision-making and isn't afraid to challenge conventional wisdom. He has a proven track record of streamlining processes and improving team performance, pushing everyone to be their best.

What distinguishes Jari is his deep understanding of the technical intricacies of motorsport combined with his ability to motivate and manage a diverse team. He fosters a culture of accountability and continuous improvement, ensuring the team operates at peak performance.

physical.description: A sturdy build with a weathered face that speaks of countless hours spent in the paddock.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and meticulously records observations.
Insists on drinking his coffee black, always at exactly 82 degrees Celsius.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought, which can be unnerving.
